svg.text: Module 01 · Sheet 2/2 · 10 states in this module · 390 × 844 mobile frames
Persist the last completed tutorial checkpoint. Tutorial match, retry and first chest are free; do not spend tickets or gems.
Numbered controls match the route rail beside each phone. Arrows lead to destination screen IDs. Dashed paths are system outcomes, not player buttons.
Starter Chest skips its timer. Explain later chest timers only after this instant reward.
Reveal is cosmetic. Grants are recorded once before animation; skipping never loses rewards.
Step 5 of 5 · Spend Gold + card copies

svg.text: Tutorial upgrade cost 100 Gold + 10 copies. Confirm deducts both once; no gems required.

g.text: Win a chest, start its timer, then open.
Earn trophies, Gold and card rewards.

svg.text: Grant first full ticket refill only once. Land on the normal hub with next goals and chest slots.
Graybox · Example economy values · Cards/Gold/Gems inspired by Clash Royale; ticket gating and timed slots are configurable Royal Scibbles mechanics.
